senses.gloss: , pl. מַחֲבוֹאִים m. (homiletic transpos. of מבח׳, as if from נָבַח) bursting forth, idle talk.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 63a:2">Men. 63ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="M00805"><he>מַחֲבַת</he></cite>) <he>דאתיא אמַחֲבוֹאֵי הפה</he> it atones for the outbursts of the mouth, <he>כדאמרי אינשי מְנַבַּח נַבּוּחֵי</he> (Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. <cite ref="H00008"><he>חב</he></cite> 2: <he>קא מבחבוחי</he>, prob. to be read <he>קא מַבַּח נַבּוּחֵי</he>) as people say ‘he blabs’. [Our w. seems to be a corrupt. for <he>מַבּוּחֵי</he>, formed like <cite ref="M00081"><he>מַבּוּעַ</he></cite>, fr. <he>נבח</he>.]
